title: Coefficient of Variation (CV)

references.label: General microbiology/quantitative methods references (ASM, FDA BAM)

explanation: Expresses standard deviation as a percentage of the mean, allowing comparison of relative variability between data sets with different units or very different magnitudes.

variables.meaning: Standard deviation of the data set
Arithmetic mean of the data set

workedExample.scenario: A data set with mean 29.67 and SD 1.53.

commonMistakes: Comparing raw standard deviations (instead of CV) between data sets with very different means — a numerically larger SD isn't necessarily more variable in relative terms.
